issues.desc: Pre-2001 dates rest on same-day news (BigKinds metadata) and the 국토교통부 역대장관 page, because gwanbo.go.kr has no files before 2001. For the 3·5 개각 of 1997 (이환균) and the 1·13 개각 of 2000 (김윤기, and hence 이건춘's end) the change was announced one day before the 임명장 (1997-03-05 vs 1997-03-06, 2000-01-13 vs 2000-01-14) and news of the announcement day already says '임명'. The start follows the 임명장 day, which is also what the ministry page lists. Later gazette notices show that the legal appointment date can precede the 임명장 ceremony (권도엽 2011-05-31 vs 2011-06-02, 유일호 2015-03-13 vs 2015-03-16), so the legal dates of these two pre-2001 spells may be one day earlier. Confidence is 'medium'.

Gazette dates that differ from ceremony or announcement dates, all resolved in favour of the gazette: 임인택 (gazette 2001-09-29, announced 2001-09-30, 임명장 planned 2001-10-04), 권도엽 (gazette 2011-05-31, 임명장 2011-06-02), 유일호 (gazette 2015-03-13, 임명장 2015-03-16), 박상우 (gazette 2023-12-23 = 임기 시작, 재가 2023-12-22, 취임식 2023-12-26), 변창흠 (gazette 2020-12-29 = 임명장, 재가 2020-12-28). The ko.wikipedia list uses ceremony dates for 권도엽, 유일호 and 박상우 and gives 2023-12-25 for 원희룡's exit, against 2023-12-22 in the news.

Two exits conflict with the 국토교통부 역대장관 page. 추병직: news of 2006-11-15/16 (서울신문, 영남일보, 대구일보, 매일신문, 부산일보) says his resignation was accepted on 2006-11-15, while the page lists 2006-11-19. 이용섭: he offered his resignation on 2008-01-28, held the 이임식 at 09:00 on 2008-02-01 and registered as a preliminary candidate that afternoon, while the page lists 2008-01-31. No acceptance date was found for 이용섭, and his end is set to 2008-02-01 (medium). The page's end dates for ministers who were replaced follow a day-before-successor convention (e.g. 오장섭 2001-08-21, 김용채 2001-09-06, 안정남 2001-09-28) and were not used where news gives the actual exit day.

Day-level continuity. Vacancies (predecessor's last day to successor's start): 2005-03-28..2005-04-06 (강동석 → 추병직), 2006-11-15..2006-12-11 (추병직 → 이용섭), 2008-02-01..2008-02-28 (이용섭 left and 건설교통부 was abolished, then 국토해양부 opened with 정종환 on 2008-02-29), 2021-04-16..2021-05-14 (변창흠 → 노형욱) and 2025-07-29..2025-07-31 (박상우 → 김윤덕). The acting list names the 차관 in office for each. Only 윤성원 (2021) is named explicitly as 장관 직무대행 in a source. All other handovers are same-day (end = successor's start) or next-day (원희룡 2023-12-22 → 박상우 2023-12-23). No overlaps.

홍지선 (appointment approved 2026-09-22) has no 관보 notice yet at the cutoff (the harvested corpus ends with 관보 제21325호 of 2026-09-18). Start rests on 연합뉴스, MBC, 경향신문 (Naver) and BigKinds metadata. Recheck against the notice. His or her gender is not stated in any source consulted and is left null. 김윤덕's end (2026-09-22) is inferred from this start.

Reorganizations. 2008-02-29: 건설교통부 was abolished and 국토해양부 created. 이용섭 had already left (2008-02-01), and 정종환 was named and heard as nominee for 건설교통부장관 but appointed 국토해양부장관 on 2008-02-29, so no spell continues across this change. 2013-03-23: 국토해양부 was renamed 국토교통부. 서승환, appointed 국토해양부장관 on 2013-03-11, received a new notice '국토교통부장관에 보함 2013. 3. 23.' (관보 제17983호), so his 국토교통부 spell has reorg_continuation true and reappointed_on_reorg true. 건설교통부 was not renamed on 1998-02-28 (법률 제5529호 continued it), so 이환균 has one spell.

The 국토교통부 page lists 김윤덕's term as '2026. 07 ~ 2026. 09'. The start year is a typo for 2025 (gazette 관보 제21057호 dates his appointment 2025. 7. 31.). The same page gives month-level dates only for 2008 onwards.

Birth-date conflicts between na_members_15_22.csv (NA API) and ko.wikipedia, left open with the NA value used: 오장섭 1947-08-13 vs 1947-03-26, 김윤덕 1966-05-23 vs 1966-07-11. 이환균 has no ko.wikipedia biography, so his birth date is null. 이건춘, 김윤기 and 홍지선 have birth years only.

Transcript leads (audit/coverage_gaps.csv). 김윤기, 오장섭, 김용채, 안정남 and 임인택 were absent from the old panel and are now spells, with all their valid-type rows inside the new bounds. The single row for '김현' (2018-03-20, 국토교통부, 1 speech) is a speaker-label error for 김현미 inside her spell. Rows for 정종환 labelled '건설교통부' (2008-09-17) and for 서승환 labelled '국토해양부' (2013-03-19) are label variants inside their spells. Rows from 국회본회의, 예산결산특별위원회 and 국정조사 that put 추병직, 이용섭, 정종환, 김현미, 강호인, 원희룡, 노형욱 and 박상우 in office years before their appointments are the misattached content described in the audit and were ignored. 김윤덕 and 홍지선 fall after the transcript coverage (ends 2025-01).
